# OfficialUM1 — LLM Site Index
# https://officialum1.com
# Updated: 2026-04-04

## About OfficialUM1
OfficialUM1 is a premium digital marketplace and digital agency founded in 2020 by Muhammad Umar Mumtaz in Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan. The platform operates across two primary verticals:

1. **Digital Marketplace**: Aged, verified social media accounts and digital assets
2. **Digital Agency**: SEO, web development, social media management, US business formation

OfficialUM1 is an active verified seller on G2G.com, one of the world's largest digital goods marketplaces. All accounts go through a 7-step verification process before delivery.

## Founder
- Name: Muhammad Umar Mumtaz
- Role: Founder & CEO
- Location: Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan
- Founded OfficialUM1: 2020
- Expertise: Full-stack development (React, Node.js, Express, Drizzle ORM), SEO strategy, social media account verification, API marketplace integration
- G2G.com: Verified seller since 2023

## Marketplace Capabilities
- Social media accounts: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter/X, Reddit, Snapchat, Discord, Telegram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, GitHub
- Account types: Aged profiles, niche-specific accounts, high-authority verified accounts
- Verification: 7-step process including age check, engagement analysis, ban history, email/phone access, live-login test
- Delivery: 1–24 hours for pre-listed products
- Guarantee: 48-hour replacement on all accounts
- Reseller program: Tiered discounts starting at 20% off for approved partners

## Agency Services
- Social media management and growth
- SEO strategy, content strategy, and link building
- Custom web platforms and API development
- US business formation services
- White-label packages for agencies
- Consulting and digital strategy

## Platform & API Integrations
- G2G.com: Official verified seller, real-time API sync for listings and orders
- Z2U: Additional marketplace integration for digital goods
- PlayerUp: Supplemental marketplace integration
- Stripe: Payment processing for credit/debit cards
- Crypto: USDT (TRC-20, ERC-20), Bitcoin payments accepted
- Wallet system: Multi-currency credit wallet for instant checkout
- Internal admin: Real-time dashboard, wallet management, order processing

## Content Policy
- All accounts listed are legally sold by their original owners
- No fake reviews or ratings — all verified purchases
- No fabricated credentials or businesses
- Buyer/seller disputes handled with documented evidence
- Replacement or refund processed within 7 business days for valid claims

## Technical Architecture
- Frontend: React + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS
- Backend: Node.js + Express
- Database: PostgreSQL (local, via Drizzle ORM) + MariaDB (external, for settings and marketplace data)
- Deployment: Replit (development) / cloud-hosted production
- API: RESTful JSON API with session authentication and HMAC-based admin tokens
